coverage.note: 核验 Federal Reserve October calendar 的 October 7 FOMC-minutes release time，以及 CME Globex notice 的 October 4/5 Compute futures listing condition、product identifiers 与平台范围；时间、条件和产品字段只取正式英文页面。
AP 的 October 1 week-ahead report 独立确认 FOMC minutes 为下周事件；Reuters brief 独立报道 CME/Silicon Data planned October 5 Compute futures launch。二者不取代一手日程或合约条件。
ForexFactory 证明 FOMC minutes 可公开发现；Reddit 显示 minutes 与 Compute futures 的当前发现/讨论。minutes 帖为方向性高风险语言，Compute 帖为 benchmark/discovery 讨论；均不证明可由既有两站准确回答的非方向性计算需求。BabyPips 当前新闻索引以数据/方向市场反应为主，没有保留可归属的计算问题。
公开可验证索引未出现可保留的当期非方向性计算需求；没有使用登录、墙后、截图或不可验证材料。

sources.freshness_role: official calendar lists October 7 2026 at 2:00 p.m. ET for FOMC Minutes from the September 15-16 meeting
independent October 1 report identifies the FOMC minutes as a coming-week macro release
public event page shows Upcoming Oct 7 2026 2:00pm; used only for discoverability, not facts or direction
same-day post names October 7 FOMC minutes but frames it as an unsafe directional fullport/size-down setup rather than a reader-specific non-directional calculation need

decision.reopen_trigger: A public attributable non-directional calculation question tied to the October 7 minutes plus an additional factual, search, example or materially distinct-window delta; any qualified work must refresh the existing FOMC article rather than create another generic event-risk shape.
decision.rationale: The official clock and independent week-ahead report satisfy factual recency, but retained public attention is direction/reaction and high-risk sizing language rather than an attributable pip-value, fixed-risk, margin, cost or portfolio-risk question. Existing FOMC packages own generic event-risk arithmetic, so changing the date or stop inputs would manufacture demand.

sources.freshness_role: official notice states Compute futures effective Sunday October 4 / trade date Monday October 5, pending regulatory review, and identifies GPU1 and GPU2
Reuters brief independently reports CME and Silicon Data's planned October 5 launch; the launch itself is within the upcoming-seven-day freshness window
same-day public discussion concerns H100/B200 rental-rate references, benchmark choice and the October 5 listing; used as attention evidence only

decision.reopen_trigger: A versioned existing-site Compute-futures workflow or a public attributable non-directional exposure/risk question that an existing calculator can accurately answer after official multiplier, tick, margin, cost and settlement inputs have all been checked.
decision.rationale: The listing clock and public discovery attention are real, but the capability map has no verified GPU1/GPU2 futures contract, tick-value, margin, commission or settlement convention workflow. A NAS100 CFD or generic stock/risk calculator cannot be represented as an accurate Compute futures answer, so no playbook or feature-gap claim is created.
